Search the documentation

Uses full-text search across the Antithesis documentation database.
The database is automatically updated before each search.

By default the query is searched as literal text. Set match to treat the
query as a raw SQLite FTS5 expression instead, enabling operators like
AND/OR/NOT/NEAR, "quoted phrases", `title:` column filters, and `prefix*`.

Returns one JSON array of {path, title, snippet} objects, best match first.
limit sets the maximum number of matches (default 10). Pass a path to the
docs_show tool to read the page.
